title: Preferred version: teach without sending again
description:
After a Delivery is sent, a person may save how it should have read, as a 'preferred version' that is never sent. This is how 'announced right away, then massaged' works when the message is already out: an email cannot be recalled and a new post costs money and attention. The person chooses separately whether to also correct the public post (a superseding Delivery, where the channel can delete) or only to teach.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Saving a preferred version sends nothing and changes no public text.
- It can be used as an example exactly like an edit made before sending.
- Correcting and teaching are separate choices.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- delivery-preferred-version.feature: a preferred version on a sent email sends nothing; it becomes an example when given a scope; choosing 'correct' on X makes a superseding Delivery and deletes the old post.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Announcements learn from a person's edits. Slice code O2 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.

comments.text: lead8: Merged in #1722 (develop, not released). announcements_preferred saves how a sent Delivery should have read, never sent, optional scope in the same step; correcting stays the separate announcements correct. Spec delivery-preferred-version.feature.
